question_data.Question: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
question_data.Paragraph: Research shows that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions. To check if something is missing, you will find yourself checking your to-do lists multiple times. Instead, organize all of your tasks in one place. It doesn't matter if you use digital or paper media. It's okay to keep your professional and personal tasks in one place. This will give you a good idea of how time is divided between work and home. This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important.

question_data.Question: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
question_data.Paragraph: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.

Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.
question_data.Options: ① We should recognize that computerization has not freed consumers from routine work. ### ② We should replace travel agents because online reservations require less consumer effort. ### ③ We should judge technological progress chiefly by the efficiency gains of companies. ### ④ We should expect self-service systems to increase the leisure time of consumers. ### ⑤ We should treat extra consumer tasks as evidence of improved company service.
question_data.Explanation: ①이 정답입니다. 필자는 컴퓨터화가 반복 노동을 줄여 여가를 늘릴 것이라는 약속과 달리, 기업의 일이 소비자에게 넘어와 오히려 시간이 줄었다고 지적한다. 따라서 소비자가 반복 업무에서 해방되지 못한 현실을 인식하라는 ①이 취지에 맞는다. ③은 소비자의 부담을 빼고 기업 효율만 보며, ④는 지문의 현실과 반대이다. ②의 수고 감소와 ⑤의 서비스 개선도 예약·포장·계산을 소비자가 맡게 된다는 비판을 왜곡한다.

question_data.Question: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
question_data.Paragraph: We tend to believe that we possess a host of socially desirable characteristics, and that we are free of most of those that are socially undesirable. For example, a large majority of the general public thinks that they are more intelligent, more fair-minded, less prejudiced, and more skilled behind the wheel of an automobile than the average person. This phenomenon is so reliable and ubiquitous that it has come to be known as the "Lake Wobegon effect," after Garrison Keillor's fictional community where "the women are strong, the men are good-looking, and all the children are above average." A survey of one million high school seniors found that 70% thought they were above average in leadership ability, and only 2% thought they were below average. In terms of ability to get along with others, all students thought they were above average, 60% thought they were in the top 10%, and 25% thought they were in the top 1%!
question_data.Options: ① the Lake Wobegon effect of overestimating one's abilities ### ② the widespread belief that people are free from socially undesirable traits ### ③ the comparison between the general public's views and high school seniors' opinions ### ④ the survey results showing high school seniors' self-assessed leadership abilities ### ⑤ the history of the term 'Lake Wobegon effect'

We tend to believe that we possess a host of socially desirable characteristics, and that we are free of most of those that are socially undesirable. In terms of ability to get along with others, all students thought they were above average, 60% thought they were in the top 10%, and 25% thought they were in the top 1%!

→ The Lake Wobegon effect describes the ubiquitous tendency for individuals to (A) ________ their socially desirable traits while (B) ________ their undesirable ones.
question_data.Options: ① (A) conceal – (B) exaggerating ### ② (A) accurately assess – (B) ignoring ### ③ (A) underestimate – (B) overestimating ### ④ (A) overestimate – (B) underestimating ### ⑤ (A) conceal – (B) revealing

(A)는 지문의 “We tend to believe that we possess a host of socially desirable characteristics”와 예시들(지능, 공정성 등 평균보다 높음)에서 알 수 있듯, 자신의 좋은 점을 ‘overestimate’하는 것을 요약합니다. (B)는 “we are free of most of those that are socially undesirable”라는 인식과 관련되어, 나쁜 점을 ‘underestimating’하거나 무시하는 태도를 의미합니다.

question_data.Paragraph: We tend to believe that we possess a host of socially ① <u>desirable</u> characteristics, and that we are free of most of those that are socially undesirable. For example, a large majority of the general public thinks that they are more intelligent, more fair-minded, less ② <u>prejudiced</u>, and more skilled behind the wheel of an automobile than the average person. This phenomenon is so reliable and ③ <u>rare</u> that it has come to be known as the "Lake Wobegon effect," after Garrison Keillor's ④ <u>fictional</u> community where "the women are strong, the men are good-looking, and all the children are above average." A survey of one million high school seniors found that 70% thought they were above average in ⑤ <u>leadership</u> ability, and only 2% thought they were below average. In terms of ability to get along with others, all students thought they were above average, 60% thought they were in the top 10%, and 25% thought they were in the top 1%!

question_data.Explanation: ③ rare를 ubiquitous 등 널리 퍼져 있다는 말로 고쳐야 한다. a large majority, 리더십에서 70%, 대인관계에서 all students라는 근거는 자기 과대평가가 드물다는 주장과 충돌한다. reliable은 이 현상이 일관되게 관찰된다는 뜻이며 자기평가가 정확하다는 뜻이 아니다. ① desirable은 자신이 갖췄다고 믿는 좋은 특성, ② prejudiced는 자신에게 적다고 여기는 편견, ④ fictional은 이름의 유래인 가상 공동체, ⑤ leadership은 설문의 평가 영역이므로 각각 문맥에 맞다.
